profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Back-end web developer in FinTech. Currently integrating Fiserv payment processing into some of the world's largest accounting and ERP software like Magento, Intuit and Salesforce. I touch half a dozen languages and technologies every day, but my heart belongs to ASP.NET Core and C#.

SPECIALTIES
• Web development using:
◘ ASP.NET 6 (MVC), EF Core, Azure
◘ LAMP Stack
• API Development
• Payment processing
• E-commerce development
• ERPs
• Game design and
development

TECHNICAL SKILLS
• ASP.NET Core 2+
• C#
• Entity Framework Core
• LAMP & MAMP
• Salesforce B2C Commerce
• Adobe Commerce (Magento)
• JavaScript
• MySQL, PostgreSQL
• Mandarin Chinese

positions.title: Developer & Founder
positions.description: A passion project turned business opportunity. I handle every aspect of a boutique, luxury leather accessories brand, from product design and production, to web design, programming, and e-commerce. My proudest achievements include growing the brand into a successful company averaging tens of thousands of dollars in revenue annually and attracting thousands of followers and fans online.

positions.title: Copywriter
positions.description:
When you need copy written, tweaked and buffed to a high shine, you come to me. I write consumer-facing and B2B advertising celebrating Whirlpool Corporation appliances. This means I spend my time cooperating with other writers, designers and clients to perfect output through detailed editing that emphasizes accuracy and consistence across all materials. My assignments have run the gamut from identity to rebate forms, including:
•	Completely rebranding Amana and Whirlpool brands
•	Populating Whirlpool brand appliances into the Home Depot online database with 100% accuracy 
•	Creating marketing materials supporting United Federal Credit Union’s geographic expansion.

positions.title: Fiction / Copy Editor
positions.description: Ah, creativity! As Editor, I selected and composed original works of fiction and poetry for each issue of Kiosk. This required collaborating with authors to revise and improve their writing. I also performed marketing duties necessary to perpetuate the magazine, including fund raising, grant writing and calls for submissions.
